messages:
Maya: Heads-up — got a billing alert for asia-east1 egress ~ $4.1k for yesterday. BigQuery shows a large number of small POSTs to a US collector. Anyone tracking trace/export traffic? :thinking:
Sam: I saw retries in the trace-agg service logs around 03:15-03:45 UTC. Lots of repeated ~500/503 then 200s, looks like chunk retry loop.
Sam: log snippet:
```
TRACE_EXPORTER trace-agg-1 POST /v1/collect 200 48KB
TRACE_EXPORTER trace-agg-1 POST /v1/collect 503 retry=1
TRACE_EXPORTER trace-agg-1 POST /v1/collect 200 48KB
TRACE_EXPORTER trace-agg-2 POST /v1/collect 502 retry=2
```
Ankur: Do we know which collector endpoint these go to (us vs apac)? can we map service -> dest region?
Lia: ran a quick BQ query grouping by dest_region and exporter_name:
```
SELECT dest_region, exporter, SUM(bytes) as bytes
FROM `billing.logs.egress_*`
WHERE DATE(event_ts) = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND service = 'trace-aggregator'
GROUP BY dest_region, exporter
ORDER BY bytes DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Lia: results showed ~92% to us-central1, exporter=otel-collector-us, ~6% to apac.
BillingBot: [billing-alert] High egress detected: project=redwood-prod, region=asia-east1, cost_delta=$4100 (24h). Details: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/summary?params=... :warning:
Maya: Found root cause — trace-agg config had EXPORT_COLLECTOR=https://traces-us.example.com set by mistake in deploy #4221. Should be regional endpoint (https://traces-apac.example.com).
Maya: env from the deploy: `EXPORT_COLLECTOR=https://traces-us.example.com; BATCH_SIZE=50; COMPRESS=false`
Sam: Oof — that flip was in the config map change yesterday morning. Rolling back the config to point to apac now.
OpsBot: deploybot: rolling config rollback initiated for trace-aggregator (deploy-id: 4224), expected completion ~2m.
Sam: After rollback we should see traffic drop — also enabling gzip on exporter to reduce bytes/sec and batching to 200.
Ankur: We should also add region-aware fallback and a small egress tag so billing queries can attribute faster. plus a guard to reject non-regional endpoints in config validation.
Lia: Filing billing support ticket and request for credits for the spike. Also opening a postmortem stub.
Maya: Thanks — monitoring egress now. If anyone sees other services with similar non-regional endpoints, ping here. :eyes:
